name: VideoEmbed
docs: A video in a fixed ratio with a poster, controls and, as a backdrop, a muted loop behind the content. Playing starts only on request; a backdrop video stops under a reduced-motion preference and shows the poster.

props.name: backdrop
props.docs: muted, looping, without controls, behind the content
